en: TCP Connect: complete the handshake
Use connect() to establish TCP, then end the test.
TCP Connect: complete the handshake
Use connect() to establish TCP, then end the test.
Scanner
Target
SYN
Scanner → target: request a connection and synchronize.
SYN+ACK
Target → scanner: accept and supply synchronization
information.
ACK
Scanner → target: complete the ordinary handshake.
TCP success still requires separate TLS, HTTP and application
checks.
SYN Scan: reset after the opening response
SYN+ACK supplies open evidence; no final ACK is sent.
SYN Scan: reset after the opening response
SYN+ACK supplies open evidence; no final ACK is sent.
Scanner
Target
SYN
Scanner → target: request a connection and synchronize.
SYN+ACK
Target → scanner: accept and supply synchronization
information.
RST
Scanner → target: reset; the ordinary handshake is incomplete.
A target RST refuses; a scanner-side RST ends this attempt.
UDP: send a datagram, interpret four outcomes
Scanner → target: UDP datagram. Cards are alternative outcomes, not a sequence.
UDP: send a datagram, interpret four outcomes
Scanner → target: UDP datagram. Cards are alternative outcomes,

open

closed

filtered
IPv4 ICMP Type 3 / Code 1, 2, 9, 10 or 13.
open|filtered
No reply after retries: possibly open and silent, or filtered.
Match ICMP to its source and original datagram; IPv4 codes do
